about_the_game:
Everyone, regardless of age or gender, has a chance to make their wish come true! The Wish Jar Festival has begun.

Players choose one character from traditional Korean folktales and participate in the Wish Jar Competition hosted by Dangun!

The Wish Jar is a kind of board game battle.

Each player puts cards into their jar—cards have numbers and symbols with special abilities. After mixing them up, they draw cards at random without seeing them.

From the cards drawn, players combine two to determine how to attack the opponent—either in terms of method or power.
They can also learn new skills to increase their attack power.

After choosing their attack skill, the game moves into a land-grabbing match—yes, just like the familiar game of territory marking.

Players decide how far to throw their flag:
The farther it’s thrown, the harder it is to retrieve!
If you encounter your opponent while going for your flag?

Use the attack skills you prepared to battle and determine the winner.
If you're afraid of losing, running away first is also an option!

The winner claims the amount of land based on how far they threw their flag!

Matches continue from preliminaries to the finals, and with rewards from each game, players can swap out cards in their jar to enhance their deck.

Add symbols with special powers or change numbers outright to gain an advantage, strengthen your deck, and aim for higher scores.
By building your deck (the cards inside your jar), you design your victory through strategy—not luck.

Additionally, there are mid-game "missions" that require certain actions, and "gifts" from sponsors that make you feel like the hero of an e-sports tournament, helping you gather more items for a stronger deck.

Use talismans you bring into the match for their effects, and the Insight system to read your opponent’s cards—bringing you one step closer to victory.

This game is a PC single-player game. Its genre is a deck-building strategy land-grabbing game.
Wish Jar offers thrilling tension, deep thinking, and the fun of strategic choices within simple rules.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Unreal Engine 5 title
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit (or Windows 10 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: A strategic board game where you become a Korean folktale hero to fulfill your wish! Combine cards with numbers and powers, strengthen your deck, and claim territory. Missions, talismans, and sponsor gifts add dynamic tension to every match!
supported_languages: English, Korean, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
